paragraphs.en: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS are our most expressive audio generation models yet. Generate custom character voices and direct scene dialogue across Google AI Studio, Gemini API, Gemini Enterprise, Gemini Notebook, and Google Vids.
paragraphs.zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS 是我们迄今为止最具表现力的音频生成模型。 通过 Google AI Studio、Gemini API、Gemini Enterprise、Gemini Notebook 和 Google Vids，生成自定义角色语音并指导场景对话。

sents.en: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS are our most expressive audio generation models yet.
sents.zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS 是我们迄今为止最具表现力的音频生成模型。

sents.en: Generate custom character voices and direct scene dialogue across Google AI Studio, Gemini API, Gemini Enterprise, Gemini Notebook, and Google Vids.
sents.zh: 通过 Google AI Studio、Gemini API、Gemini Enterprise、Gemini Notebook 和 Google Vids，生成自定义角色语音并指导场景对话。

paragraphs.en: Director, Research Science, on Behalf of the Gemini Audio Team
paragraphs.zh: 研究科学总监，代表 Gemini 音频团队

paragraphs.en: Google just launched new AI tools that let you create and customize realistic voices from scratch. You can direct these voices to sound exactly how you want, from their accent to their emotional tone. It’s perfect for making audiobooks, games, or podcasts that sound like real people talking. Plus, they added safety features to make sure these voices are used responsibly.
paragraphs.zh: 谷歌刚刚推出了新的AI工具，让你可以从零开始创建并定制逼真的语音。 你可以精准地控制这些语音的呈现效果，从口音到情感语调，都能按你的要求调整。 它非常适合制作听起来像真人说话的有声书、游戏或播客。 此外，他们还加入了安全功能，以确保这些语音得到负责任的使用。

sents.en: Google just launched new AI tools that let you create and customize realistic voices from scratch.
sents.zh: 谷歌刚刚推出了新的AI工具，让你可以从零开始创建并定制逼真的语音。

sents.en: You can direct these voices to sound exactly how you want, from their accent to their emotional tone.
sents.zh: 你可以精准地控制这些语音的呈现效果，从口音到情感语调，都能按你的要求调整。

sents.en: It’s perfect for making audiobooks, games, or podcasts that sound like real people talking.
sents.zh: 它非常适合制作听起来像真人说话的有声书、游戏或播客。

sents.en: Plus, they added safety features to make sure these voices are used responsibly.
sents.zh: 此外，他们还加入了安全功能，以确保这些语音得到负责任的使用。

paragraphs.en: Today, we’re introducing two new text-to-speech models to the Gemini family, transforming voice generation from static presets into a dynamic creative studio. These models enable creators, developers, and enterprises to create richer, more expressive audio experiences, while enabling improved user experiences in products like Gemini Notebook and Google Vids .
paragraphs.zh: 今天，我们向 Gemini 家族推出两款全新的文本转语音模型，将语音生成从静态预设转变为一个动态的创意工作室。 这些模型使创作者、开发者和企业能够打造更丰富、更具表现力的音频体验，同时让 Gemini Notebook 和 Google Vids 等产品中的用户体验得到提升。

sents.en: Today, we’re introducing two new text-to-speech models to the Gemini family, transforming voice generation from static presets into a dynamic creative studio.
sents.zh: 今天，我们向 Gemini 家族推出两款全新的文本转语音模型，将语音生成从静态预设转变为一个动态的创意工作室。

sents.en: These models enable creators, developers, and enterprises to create richer, more expressive audio experiences, while enabling improved user experiences in products like Gemini Notebook and Google Vids .
sents.zh: 这些模型使创作者、开发者和企业能够打造更丰富、更具表现力的音频体验，同时让 Gemini Notebook 和 Google Vids 等产品中的用户体验得到提升。

paragraphs.en: These models complement our fast-growing Gemini Audio family, following 3.5 Live Translate , 3.5 Transcribe , 3.8 Live, and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking .
paragraphs.zh: 这些模型是对我们快速增长 Gemini 音频系列的补充，此前已发布 3.5 Live Translate、3.5 Transcribe、3.8 Live 和 3.8 Live Extended Thinking。

paragraphs.en: Scale up from 30 original voices to an infinite library. Whether you need an entirely original character voice or a consistent brand ambassador, our 3.8 Flash TTS model powers a full vocal studio. This enables you to create and use expressive, natural-sounding voices for every moment, while empowering developers and enterprises to easily build custom audio experiences.
paragraphs.zh: 从 30 个原始音色扩展至无限音色库。 无论您需要一个完全原创的角色声音，还是一个稳定一致的品牌代言人，我们的 3.8 Flash TTS 模型都能为您打造一个完整的语音工作室。 这使您能够为每一个时刻创建并使用富有表现力、自然逼真的声音，同时助力开发者和企业轻松构建自定义音频体验。

sents.en: Scale up from 30 original voices to an infinite library.
sents.zh: 从 30 个原始音色扩展至无限音色库。

sents.en: Whether you need an entirely original character voice or a consistent brand ambassador, our 3.8 Flash TTS model powers a full vocal studio.

paragraphs.en: Hear how Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS generates a high-energy DJ voice from Melbourne.
paragraphs.zh: 听听 Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 如何生成来自墨尔本的高能量 DJ 语音。

paragraphs.en: Hear how Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS generates a super-tinny, monotone robot voice.
paragraphs.zh: 听听 Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 如何生成超单薄、单调的机器人语音。

paragraphs.en: Hear how Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS brings a Japanese dragon to life.
paragraphs.zh: 听听 Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 如何让一条日本龙栩栩如生。

paragraphs.en: Once you've selected your voices, both TTS models give you precise control over how each line is delivered.
paragraphs.zh: 一旦你选定了声音，两个 TTS 模型都能让你精准控制每一行台词的演绎方式。

paragraphs.en: Hear how Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS enables natural, highly expressive conversations for interactive voice agents.
paragraphs.zh: 了解 Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 如何为交互式语音智能体实现自然、极具表现力的对话。

paragraphs.en: Watch and hear how Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS uses granular script control to build a deeply engaging, immersive audio experience.
paragraphs.zh: 观看并聆听 Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 如何利用精细的脚本控制，打造深度吸引人的沉浸式音频体验。

paragraphs.en: See how Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS turns natural language prompts into bespoke vocal personas from scratch.
paragraphs.zh: 了解 Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 如何将自然语言提示从零开始转化为定制化的声音人格。

paragraphs.en: Watch how Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS enables creators to design custom scenes to bring animated dialogue to life.
paragraphs.zh: 了解 Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 如何帮助创作者设计自定义场景，让动画对话栩栩如生。

paragraphs.en: See how Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS turns scripts into fully performed dialogue scenes, letting creators direct vocal delivery, and natural turn-taking.
paragraphs.zh: 看看 Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 如何将剧本转化为完整的对话场景演绎，让创作者能够指导语音表达和自然的轮流对话。

paragraphs.en: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS delivers leading voice customization capabilities, securing the #1 overall spot on Hume AI’s Voice Design Benchmark (71.4) and also leading in accent modeling (60.8).
paragraphs.zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 提供领先的语音定制能力，在 Hume AI 的语音设计基准测试（Voice Design Benchmark）中以 71.4 分位居综合排名第一，并在口音建模（accent modeling）方面同样以 60.8 分领先。

paragraphs.en: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS enable truly expressive performances without sacrificing reliability, also securing the #1 and #2 spots respectively on Hume AI’s Overall Quality Index. The model shows major improvements on a wide range of use cases such as long-form content and dual-speaker screenplay control compared to Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS.
paragraphs.zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS 能够实现真正富有表现力的演绎，同时不牺牲可靠性，并分别在 Hume AI 的整体质量指数（Overall Quality Index）上斩获第一名和第二名。 与 Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS 相比，该模型在长篇内容和双说话人剧本控制等广泛的使用场景中展现出重大改进。

sents.en: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS enable truly expressive performances without sacrificing reliability, also securing the #1 and #2 spots respectively on Hume AI’s Overall Quality Index.
sents.zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS 和 Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS 能够实现真正富有表现力的演绎，同时不牺牲可靠性，并分别在 Hume AI 的整体质量指数（Overall Quality Index）上斩获第一名和第二名。

sents.en: The model shows major improvements on a wide range of use cases such as long-form content and dual-speaker screenplay control compared to Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS.
sents.zh: 与 Gemini 3.1 Flash TTS 相比，该模型在长篇内容和双说话人剧本控制等广泛的使用场景中展现出重大改进。

paragraphs.en: In blind human preference evaluations on Voice Arena , Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash-Lite TTS secure top positions amongst competitors in key global languages, including Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese, Vietnamese, Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), Mexican Spanish and Hindi. With support for over 100 languages, these models empower creators, developers, and enterprises to build high-quality, multilingual voice experiences worldwide.
paragraphs.zh: 在 Voice Arena 的盲测人类偏好评估中，Gemini 3.8 Flash 和 Flash-Lite TTS 在多种关键全球语言（包括日语、巴西葡萄牙语、越南语、现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）、墨西哥西班牙语和印地语）中位居竞争对手前列。 这些模型支持超过 100 种语言，助力创作者、开发者和企业在全球范围内构建高质量的多语言语音体验。

sents.en: In blind human preference evaluations on Voice Arena , Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash-Lite TTS secure top positions amongst competitors in key global languages, including Japanese, Brazilian Portuguese, Vietnamese, Modern Standard Arabic (MSA), Mexican Spanish and Hindi.
sents.zh: 在 Voice Arena 的盲测人类偏好评估中，Gemini 3.8 Flash 和 Flash-Lite TTS 在多种关键全球语言（包括日语、巴西葡萄牙语、越南语、现代标准阿拉伯语（MSA）、墨西哥西班牙语和印地语）中位居竞争对手前列。

paragraphs.en: We built our voice creation and replication capabilities with strict safeguards to help protect voice talent, respect identity, and ensure content transparency. For voice replication our system leverages consent verification: users must provide a verbal consent recording from the voice owner that matches the reference speaker before a voice can be created.
paragraphs.zh: 我们在构建语音创建与复刻能力时采用了严格的安全保障措施，以帮助保护配音人才、尊重个人身份并确保内容透明。 在语音复刻方面，我们的系统采用同意验证机制：用户必须提供一段来自声音所有者、且与参考说话人相匹配的口头同意录音，才能创建该声音。

sents.en: We built our voice creation and replication capabilities with strict safeguards to help protect voice talent, respect identity, and ensure content transparency.
sents.zh: 我们在构建语音创建与复刻能力时采用了严格的安全保障措施，以帮助保护配音人才、尊重个人身份并确保内容透明。

sents.en: For voice replication our system leverages consent verification: users must provide a verbal consent recording from the voice owner that matches the reference speaker before a voice can be created.
sents.zh: 在语音复刻方面，我们的系统采用同意验证机制：用户必须提供一段来自声音所有者、且与参考说话人相匹配的口头同意录音，才能创建该声音。

paragraphs.en: More broadly, every audio clip generated by our Gemini Audio models is watermarked with SynthID . This imperceptible watermark is woven directly into the audio output, ensuring AI-generated speech remains detectable to help prevent misinformation. For more details on our approach to safety and responsibility, review the model card .
paragraphs.zh: 更广泛地说，我们 Gemini 音频模型生成的每一段音频都带有 SynthID 水印。 这种不可感知的水印直接编织在音频输出中，确保 AI 生成的语音仍可被检测，以帮助防止错误信息传播。 有关我们在安全与责任方面做法的更多详情，请查阅模型卡。

sents.en: This imperceptible watermark is woven directly into the audio output, ensuring AI-generated speech remains detectable to help prevent misinformation.

paragraphs.en: Starting today, developers can experience these new speech generation capabilities in Google AI Studio . Built like a voice design workspace, you can prompt entirely new vocal identities from scratch or replicate your own voice 1 , then bring them directly into a dual-speaker screenplay editor to direct line-by-line delivery.
paragraphs.zh: 从今天起，开发者可以在 Google AI Studio 中体验这些全新的语音生成功能。 它的构建方式类似于一个语音设计工作区，你可以完全从零开始提示生成全新的声音身份，或复制你自己的声音 1 ，然后将它们直接带入双说话人剧本编辑器中，逐行指导台词的演绎方式。

paragraphs.zh: 在 Google AI Studio 中尝试声音复刻功能。

paragraphs.en: By using the Gemini API, developer platforms such as Agora , LiveKit , Pipecat , Vercel enable developers to build and deploy high-performance speech generation experiences with ease.
paragraphs.zh: 通过使用 Gemini API，Agora、LiveKit、Pipecat、Vercel 等开发者平台使开发者能够轻松构建和部署高性能的语音生成体验。

paragraphs.en: We’re partnering with companies like Figma, HeyGen, Linguana, Wondercraft, 99.co, and Ollang, who are integrating our latest TTS models to help accelerate global dubbing, localize media with nuanced regional accents, and power conversational voice agents at scale.
paragraphs.zh: 我们正在与 Figma、HeyGen、Linguana、Wondercraft、99.co 和 Ollang 等公司合作，这些公司正在集成我们最新的 TTS 模型，以帮助加速全球配音、通过细腻的地方口音实现媒体本地化，并大规模驱动对话式语音智能体。
